name: code_read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset (and other) email links are built from BASE_URL, which falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever the PUBLIC_URL environment variable isn't set (line 8). Since users are getting localhost links in production, PUBLIC_URL is apparently missing or not being read correctly after the last release. The fix should ensure PUBLIC_URL is set to the real production URL in the deployment config, and/or templates.ts should fail loudly instead of silently falling back to localhost when running outside development.

input.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and this fallback is being used in production, causing password reset (and other) email links to point at localhost instead of the real site. Ensure PUBLIC_URL is properly configured/injected for the production environment, and consider making the lack of a configured PUBLIC_URL fail loudly in production (e.g. throw or log an error) rather than silently falling back to localhost, so this kind of misconfiguration is caught before emails go out.
